task_instance: Add devcontainer support to a small Node/TypeScript sample project (package.json + tsconfig.json + package-lock.json), following the skill's reconnaissance -> detect -> generate -> write workflow: infer project name/slug from package.json, detect Node/TypeScript stack, and generate the 5 required .devcontainer/ output files (Dockerfile, devcontainer.json, post_install.py, .zshrc, install.sh) with placeholders substituted and Node-specific extensions/settings/postCreateCommand applied.
blocker_detail: Full end-to-end verification via `docker build` got through pulling the base image, running apt-get update, and installing the custom CA cert, but the subsequent apt package install step failed because the sandbox's outbound proxy (127.0.0.1:40557) is only reachable from the host network namespace, not from inside a Docker container's bridge network -- this is a nested-network limitation of the sandbox, not a flaw in the generated devcontainer files, and did not block the actual deliverable (the generated, validated config files).
evidence: Created sample project at sample-project/{package.json,tsconfig.json,package-lock.json} (name 'hello-widget' -> PROJECT_NAME 'Hello Widget', PROJECT_SLUG 'hello-widget'). Generated sample-project/.devcontainer/{Dockerfile,devcontainer.json,post_install.py,.zshrc,install.sh} per the skill's Base Template Features (uv/Python 3.13, fnm/Node 22, ast-grep, bubblewrap/socat, iptables/ipset with NET_ADMIN, ripgrep/fd/fzf/tmux/git-delta, read-only .devcontainer mount, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY remoteEnv) plus the Node/TypeScript section (eslint+prettier extensions/settings, postCreateCommand chained as 'uv run /opt/post_install.py && npm ci' since package-lock.json is present). Ran the skill's Validation Checklist programmatically: `python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('.devcontainer/devcontainer.json'))"` succeeded (valid JSON, no trailing commas); `grep -c '{{PROJECT' .devcontainer/*` returned 0 in every file (no leftover placeholders). Also attempted a real `docker build -f .devcontainer/Dockerfile .devcontainer` after starting dockerd in the sandbox: base image pulled successfully, custom CA bundle installed via update-ca-certificates, apt-get update ran; the build then failed at package installation only because the container's network namespace could not reach the sandbox's host-bound outbound proxy (Could not connect to host.docker.internal:40557 - Connection refused), a sandbox networking constraint unrelated to the generated files' correctness. Files produced (all under the work directory): sample-project/.devcontainer/Dockerfile, .../devcontainer.json, .../post_install.py, .../.zshrc, .../install.sh.
